fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM58,705. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0005970/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass SPM/SPMV or equivalent with a Credit in any three (3) subjects (priority will be given to a Credit in English Language); OR Certificate from Polytechnic, IPTA, or accredited IPTS; OR Pass Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least a B in three (3) subjects; OR Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
